dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: Say, if I can learn how to cook, would I be able to open a shop with Ryouko?

dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: I tried cooking recently, but it feels like I'm not made out of the right stuff for a chef...

dialogues.speaker: Yegor
dialogues.text: Have a try. Is my cooking really that bad...?
